page_title: TOR 1-1 GEN | Torino v Genoa 08/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+7' Referee Ermano Feliciani signals NO PENALTY for Torino after a VAR review!
90+7' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
90+5' There's a break in play and referee Ermano Feliciani must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Torino using VAR. This could be interesting!
90+4' PENALTY APPEAL by Torino, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!

90+1' Cesare Casadei (Torino) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just wide of the left post. Unlucky! The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
90+1' The referee awards a corner and Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) goes over to take it.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Junior Messias (Genoa) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
86' Ermano Feliciani shows a yellow card to Alan Matturro (Genoa), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
85' Paolo Vanoli decides to make a substitution. Nikola Vlasic will be replaced by Antonio Sanabria (Torino).
84' A corner kick by Genoa is thwarted by the well prepared Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino).
83' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Stefano Sabelli (Genoa).
82' Fouls committed – 9:9.
78' Patrick Vieira has decided to substitute Andrea Pinamonti and he is replaced by Caleb Ekuban (Genoa).
75' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
75' Junior Messias (Genoa) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
75' Samuele Ricci (Torino) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
74' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) comes onto the pitch for Borna Sosa.
71' Paolo Vanoli has decided to make a change. Marcus Pedersen (Torino) replaces Valentino Lazaro.
71' It is time for a substitution. Cesare Casadei (Torino) is on for Yann Karamoh.
70' Today's referee Ermano Feliciani rightly decides to book Saul Coco (Torino) for his harsh tackle.

68' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa). Junior Messias plays a through ball and finds Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalpeeper and fire a close-range shot into the top right corner. It's now 1:1.
67' Genoa are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
61' We are about to witness a subsitution. Patrizio Masini (Genoa) for Milan Badelj.
60' A pass by Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
56' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
56' Yann Karamoh (Torino) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Torino win a corner.

55' That was close by Che Adams (Torino)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
53' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but Nicola Leali is equal to it and makes an easy save.
52' Here is a change. Fabio Miretti is going off and Patrick Vieira gives the last tactical orders to Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa).
52' Here comes a substitution. Vitinha is given a rest as he is replaced by Junior Messias (Genoa).
50' Yann Karamoh (Torino) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
48' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' 1 - 0 It's an own goal! An unlucky moment for Morten Thorsby (Genoa), who heads the corner kick behind his own keeper. The score is 1:0.
45+1' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' The ball possession is 60:40.
36' Aaron Martin (Genoa) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
36' Aaron Martin (Genoa) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Genoa will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
31' Paolo Vanoli is forced to make a change. Adrien Tameze is unable to continue due to injury, Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) comes on.
29' Adrien Tameze (Torino) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

27' Borna Sosa (Torino) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Nicola Leali was alert and the score remained the same.
22' 3:1 – the total goal attempt statistics.
17' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
14' Vitinha (Genoa) commits a rough challenge and Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle for a foul.

11' Torino slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
9' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
9' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) makes a rough challenge and Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle for a foul. Torino win a free kick.
7' Borna Sosa (Torino) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

7' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the middle of the goal. Nicola Leali is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. Corner kick. Torino will have an opportunity.
6' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
6' Milan Badelj (Genoa) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Nicola Leali displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Che Adams (Torino) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Genoa, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
2' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Ermano Feliciani blows for a foul. Genoa are awarded the free kick.
2' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Genoa will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Ermano Feliciani.
